blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We investigate the transferability of identity-recognition representations to gender and age estimation from face and ocular images. Three CNNs of varying complexity, pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, are evaluated using fixed features with SVMs and end-to-end adaptation. Experiments use 11,299 frontal smartphone images from Adience, following its predefined five-fold protocol and subject-disjoint validation. Results show that domain-matched identity pre-training outperforms direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation in end-to-end training, while combining both ocular regions narrows the gap with full-face estimation, especially for age. We additionally introduce an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups and consistently improves 1-off accuracy across architectures and input regions. Across the evaluated configurations, best gender accuracies reach 88.1% for the face and 82.9% for combined ocular regions, while age estimation reaches 59.0% exact and 93.1% 1-off accuracy for ocular images, versus 57.6% and 95.2% for the full face. To our knowledge, these are the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.
blocks.zh: 我们调查身份识别表述从面部和视觉图像向性别和年龄估计的可转移性。 三种复杂程度不一的CNN,为面部或视觉身份识别预先训练,使用带有SVM的固定特性和端到端的适应性来评价. 实验使用来自Adience的11,299个前置智能手机图像,遵循其预先定义的五倍协议和主题偏差验证. 结果表明,与域匹配的身份前期培训超越了直接的ImageNet,并在端到端培训中抓取初始化,同时将两个视网膜区域结合起来,缩小差距与全面估计,特别是年龄估计。 此外,我们还引入了利用各年龄组的秩序的常规损失,并不断提高各架构和输入区域的1-1精确度。 在整个评估的配置中,面部最佳性别加速率达到88.1%,综合视力地区达到82.9%,而年龄估计则达到59.0%,视力图像为93.1%,而全面为57.6%,95.2%。 据我们所知,这是关于Adience报告的最高视力年龄。

blocks.en: 1 INTRODUCTION
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Soft-biometric attributes, such as age and gender, provide complementary information for biometric recognition, subject filtering, and attribute-dependent applications [ Dantcheva et al., 2016 , Becerra-Riera et al., 2019 ] .
Although most research relies on the full face, its visibility can be limited by pose, occlusion, or acquisition conditions [ Kim et al., 2026 ] .
The ocular or periocular region often remains visible and contains useful information for identity and soft-biometric estimation [ Sharma and Ross, 2023 , Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2024 , Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2026a ] .
However, the reduced facial information in the ocular area makes demographic estimation more challenging.
blocks.zh:
年龄和性别等软生物计量属性为生物识别,主体过滤,属性依赖应用提供了补充信息[Dantcheva等人,2016年,Becerra-Riera等人,2019年].
虽然大多数研究都依赖于全面,但其能见度可以受到姿势,隐蔽,或获取条件的限制[Kim等人,2026].
显眼或透视区域经常保持可见,并包含用于身份和软生物计量估计的有用信息[Sharma and Ross, 2023, Alonso-Fernandez等人, 2024, Alonso-Fernandez等人, 2026a]].
然而,视觉地区的面部信息减少,使得人口估计更具挑战性.

blocks.en:
This paper addresses age and gender estimation from frontal smartphone imagery.
We use Adience [ Eidinger et al., 2014 ] , an in-the-wild dataset of Flickr images providing a more demanding setup than controlled databases [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2026a ] .
Age and gender estimation from full-face Adience images has evolved from handcrafted descriptors [ Eidinger et al., 2014 , Bhattacharyya et al., 2019 ] and conventional CNNs [ Levi and Hassner, 2015 , Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] to specialised architectures exploiting local/global information [ Fang et al., 2019 ] , attention, recurrent modules [ Zhang et al., 2020 ] , and transformers [ Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023 , Singh and Singh, 2024 ] .
Some recent approaches also rely on large external datasets labelled for age and gender.
In contrast, fewer works have addressed ocular soft biometrics, using CNNs [ Rattani et al., 2017 , Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 , Ghrban and Abbadi, 2023 ] and handcrafted descriptors [ Bhattacharyya et al., 2019 ] .
The performance gap with full-face estimation remains substantial, particularly for age.
Direct comparisons are also complicated by differences in Adience subsets used, evaluation protocols, age-group definitions, and external training data.
blocks.zh:
本文从前置智能手机图像中阐述年龄和性别估计.
我们使用Adience[Eidinger等人,2014年],这是一个Flickr图像的全天候数据集,提供比控制数据库更严格的设置[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2026a].
年龄和性别估计来自全面的 " 双重 " 图像,从手动描述[Eidinger等人,2014年,Bhattacharyya等人,2019年]和常规 CNNs [Levi and Hassner, 2015, Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021] 利用本地/全球信息的专业建筑 [Fang et al., 2019], 关注, 经常模块 [Zhang et al., 2020], 以及变压器 [库普拉谢维奇和托尔斯泰赫,2023年,辛格和辛格,2024年].
最近的一些方法还依赖于贴上年龄和性别标签的大型外部数据集。
相比之下,处理视觉软生物特征的作品较少,使用CNN[Rattani等人,2017年;Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年;Ghrban和Abbadi,2023年]和手动描述符[Bhattacharyya等人,2019年].
全面估计的业绩差距仍然很大,特别是在年龄方面。
直接比较还因所使用的Adience子集、评价协议、年龄组定义和外部培训数据的差异而复杂化。

blocks.en:
Here, we investigate the transferability of biometric identity representations to age and gender estimation from full-face and ocular images.
Our contributions are threefold: i i ) evaluating three CNNs of varying complexity pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition, using fixed feature extraction and end-to-end adaptation, and comparing end-to-end training with direct ImageNet and scratch initialisation to assess the benefits of identity pre-training; i ​ i ii ) investigating the benefits of combining both ocular regions to narrow the performance gap with full-face estimation, especially for age; and i ​ i ​ i iii ) introducing an ordinal loss that exploits the ordering of age groups to improve age estimation.
Our approach improves previous ocular age results on the same Adience subset [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] by more than 10% (exact accuracy) and 7-9% (1-off accuracy), representing, to the best of our knowledge, the highest ocular age accuracies reported on Adience.
blocks.zh:
在此,我们调查生物鉴别特征的可转让性,即从全面和透视图像到年龄和性别估计。
我们的贡献有三个方面: ii)评价三种复杂程度不一的CNN进行面部或视力识别前培训,使用固定特征提取和端到端的适应,并将端到端培训与直接的ImageNet和抓痕初始化进行比较,以评估身份前培训的效益;iii)调查将两个视差区域结合起来以缩小性能差距与全面估计,特别是年龄估计的效益;iiiiiiiiiiiiiii)引入了一种线性损失,利用年龄组的顺序来改进年龄估计.
我们的方法将以前对同一Adience子集[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]的视年龄结果提高了10%以上(准确准确性)和7-9%(1-off准确性),就我们所知,这是关于Adience报告的最高视年龄急性。

blocks.en: 2 NETWORKS FOR GENDER AND AGE CLASSIFICATION
blocks.zh: 2个性别和年龄分类网

blocks.en:
We evaluate three backbones of varying complexity, depth, and parameters (Table 1 ): SqueezeNet [ Iandola et al., 2016 ] (light), MobileNetv2 [ Sandler et al., 2018 ] (medium) and ResNet50 [ He et al., 2016 ] (large).
SqueezeNet (SQ) achieves a compact architecture through squeeze-and-expand modules, MobileNetV2 (MB2) employs inverted residuals and depth-wise separable convolutions to reduce computational cost, and ResNet50 (R50) uses residual connections that bypass intermediate layers to facilitate the training of deep networks.
blocks.zh:
我们评价三种不同复杂性、深度和参数的骨干(表1):SqueezeNet[Iandola等人,2016年](轻)、MobileNetv2[Sandler等人,2018年](中)和ResNet50[He等人,2016年](大)。
SqueezeNet(SQ)通过挤和拓宽模块实现一个紧凑的架构,MobileNetV2(MB2)采用倒置的残基和深度的可分解的编组来降低计算成本,ResNet50(R50)使用绕过中间层的剩余连接来方便深层网络的培训.

blocks.en:
We use MATLAB R2024b models adapted to 113 × \times 113 inputs by changing the stride of the first convolutional layer from 2 to 1.
This preserves the remaining architecture and allows reuse of ImageNet weights where applicable.
Input images are normalised by subtracting 127.5 and dividing by 128.
For SqueezeNet, we follow [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2020 ] and add batch normalisation between convolutions and ReLU (missing in the original model).
blocks.zh:
我们使用MATLAB R2024b 型号,通过将第一个演化层的步态从2改为1来适应113×x\time113输入.
这保留了剩余架构,并允许酌情重新使用ImageNet权重.
输入图像通过减去127.5除以128实现正常化.
对于SqueezeNet,我们追随[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2020年],并加入批量的革命和ReLU正常化(在原始模型中缺失).

blocks.en: 3 EXPERIMENTAL FRAMEWORK
blocks.zh: 3 警告框架

blocks.en: 3.1 Database
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据库

blocks.en:
We use the Adience benchmark [ Eidinger et al., 2014 ] , designed for age and gender classification.
It comprises unconstrained smartphone images from Flickr, exhibiting substantial variability in pose and lighting (Figure 2 ).
From the original 26,580 images of 2,284 subjects, we use the frontal subset of [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] which removed non-frontal images to simulate selfie captures, comprising 11,299 images (5,946 females and 5,353 males). The class distribution is given in Table 2 .
The age distribution is imbalanced across groups and folds, which may affect classification performance and variability.
Facial landmarks are detected using MTCNN [ Zhang et al., 2016 ] . Images are rotated to align the eye axis and scaled to the average inter-eye distance of 105 pixels.
A 224 × \times 224 face crop is extracted around the landmark centroid, together with two 105 × \times 105 ocular crops centred on each eye. All crops are resized to 113 × \times 113 for CNN input.
Left eye crops are horizontally flipped to enforce a common canonical orientation, consistent with the recognition networks used in our experiments [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2026b ] .
blocks.zh:
我们使用为年龄和性别分类设计的Adience基准[Eidinger等人,2014年]。
它由Flickr的不受限制的智能手机图像组成,在姿势和照明方面表现出很大的差异(图2)。
从最初的26,580幅2,284个对象的图像中,我们用[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]的正面子集来去除非正面图像来模拟自拍捕获,包括11,299幅图像(5,946位女性和5,353位男性). 班级分布见表2。
年龄分布在群体和折叠之间不平衡,可能影响分类表现和可变性.
利用 MTCNN 检测到表层地标[张等,2016]. 图像旋转以对齐眼轴,并缩放到105像素的平均眼间距离.
224×时×224面部作物在地标性小行星周围提取,同时以每只眼睛为中心的两株105×时××时×105面部作物. 所有农作物的大小调整为113×××时113分用于CNN输入.
左眼作物横向翻转,以强制实施共同的犬目定向,与我们实验中使用的识别网络一致[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2026b].

blocks.en: 3.2 Protocol
blocks.zh: 3.2 议定书

blocks.en:
The Adience benchmark specifies a predefined five-fold protocol with disjoint Flickr albums across training and test sets.
Although each album may contain multiple identities, the ground truth provides subject IDs for each image, with no identities shared across albums. Thus, the folds are also subject-disjoint.
For each test fold, the remaining four folds are used for training and validation. Results are reported as mean accuracy and standard deviation across the five folds.
Following [ Eidinger et al., 2014 ] , we also report 1-off age accuracy, which considers predictions within one age group of the true class as correct.
Face training images are augmented with horizontal mirroring and gamma correction ( γ \gamma =0.5, 1, 1.5), following [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] , yielding six samples per original face image to mitigate overfitting and illumination changes.
For ocular images, the eye crops undergo the same gamma transformations, also giving six training eye samples per face image.
Thus, both modalities have the same number of training samples.
blocks.zh:
Adience基准规定预先设定的五倍协议,
虽然每张专辑可能包含多个身份,但地面真相为每张图像提供了主题ID,没有跨专辑共享身份. 因此,折叠也是主题不关联的.
对于每个测试折叠,其余四个折叠用于培训和验证. 报告的结果为平均准确性以及五折叠的标准偏差。
继[Eidinger等人,2014年]之后,我们还报告了1-off年龄的准确性,认为真实阶级中一个年龄组内的预测是正确的.
在[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]之后,通过横向镜像和伽马校正(γ\gamma = 0.5, 1, 1.5)来增强面部训练图像,每原始面部图像产生6个样本,以减轻过度配色和照明变化.
对于视觉影像来说,眼部作物经历同样的伽玛变形,也给每个面部影像提供了6个训练眼样本.
因此,两种模式的培训样本数量相同。

blocks.en:
Soft-biometrics classification is done using two approaches (Figure 1 ): i i ) a linear SVM [ Vapnik, 1995 ] with CNN-extracted features, and i ​ i ii ) CNNs trained end-to-end. SVMs use identity-pretrained CNN features from the layer preceding the classifier (Table 1 ), whereas end-to-end models additionally evaluate with scratch and ImageNet initialisations.
SVMs are trained with MATLAB’s fitclinear with default settings, except for PostFitBias=true .
For age estimation, a one-vs-one multi-class strategy with N ⁡ ( N − 1 ) / 2 N(N-1)/2 binary SVMs is used, with the class determined by majority voting.
In end-to-end training, batch normalisation and 50% dropout are applied before the fully connected layer.
The networks are trained with cross-entropy loss and SGDM with momentum 0.9, batch size 128, learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} multiplied by 0.1 every two epochs, L2 regularisation 10 − 4 10^{-4} , and up to 15 epochs with early stopping based on validation loss (patience 5).
The model with the lowest validation loss is retained.
Experiments are done in MATLAB R2024b on an NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti GPU.
blocks.zh:
软生物计量分类采用两种方法(图1): i i ) 线性 SVM [Vapnik,1995] 具有CNN的摘录功能,i ii ) CNN训练端对端. SVM使用分类器前的层层中经过身份预先训练的CNN功能(表1),而端到端的模型则附加了抓取和图像网初始化的评价.
SVMs 使用 MATLAB 的fitclinear 进行默认设置培训, 除了 PostFitBias= true 。
对于年龄估计,采用一V-一的多级策略,其中NQ(N− 1)/2N(N-1)/2二进制SVM,等级由多数投票决定.
在端到端培训中,在完全连接的层之前,实行批量正常化和50%的辍学。
网络的训练为跨内损和SGDM,动力为0.9,批量尺寸为128,学习率为10−3 10×3×3}乘以每两个纪元0.1,L2正规化为10−4 10×4},根据验证损失(patience 5)的早期停运最多为15个纪元.
鉴定损失最低的模型予以保留.
在NVIDIA RTX 2080 Ti GPU上用MATLAB R2024b进行实验.

blocks.en:
We use the same Adience subset, augmentation, and five-fold protocol as in our previous study [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] , but adopt a stricter validation.
For each fold, training subjects are split 90%/10% into subject-disjoint training and validation subsets, stratified by age and gender, with selection also ensuring an approximate 90%/10% image ratio within each age-gender group.
In contrast, [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] reserved 20% of images per class for validation without explicitly enforcing subject-disjoint subsets.
blocks.zh:
我们使用与上次研究相同的Adience子集、增强和五倍协议[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年],但采用了更严格的验证。
培训科目每套90%/10%分为按年龄和性别分级的分门别类的分门别类培训和鉴定子类,选题还可确保每个年龄组的图像比例达到90%/10%左右。
相比之下,[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]将每类20%的图像保留用于验证,而没有明确执行主题-离合子集.

blocks.en: 4 RESULTS
blocks.zh: 4项结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Models pre-trained for identity
blocks.zh: 4.1 身份预先培训的模型

blocks.en:
The CNNs are pre-trained for face or ocular identity recognition on two large databases.
All identity-pretrained CNNs were initially trained on ImageNet.
For face recognition [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2025 ] ,
the models were subsequently trained on the RetinaFace-cleaned MS1M dataset [ Guo et al., 2016 ] (5.1M images, 93.4K identities) and then fine-tuned on VGGFace2 [ Cao et al., 2018 ] (3.14M images, 8631 identities).
For ocular recognition, the models were trained on 1.9M ocular crops from VGGFace2, following [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2026b ] .
blocks.zh:
CNN在两个大型数据库中进行面部或视力识别预训.
所有身份前训练有素的CNN最初都接受了ImageNet的培训.
关于脸部识别[阿隆索-费尔南德斯等人,2025年],
随后,这些模型接受了RetinaFace清洁的MS1M数据集[Guo等人,2016年](5.1M图像,93.4K身份)的培训,然后在VGFace2[Cao等人,2018年](3.14M图像,8631身份)上进行了微调.
为了辨识视力,这些模型接受了VGGFace2型1.9M型望远镜作物的培训,随后[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2026b]。

blocks.en:
Tables 3 , 4 show gender and age accuracies using fixed CNN features and SVM classification.
We compare feature-wise standardisation to zero mean and unit variance typical of SVMs (fitted on training folds), and sample-wise L2 normalisation (which does not require training).
Results are reported using either the whole face or the ocular region as input.
‘Ocular’ columns refer to the left and right eye classified individually, whereas ‘Ocular L+R’ averages both eye descriptors before SVM classification.
blocks.zh:
表3、表4显示了使用CNN固定特征和SVM分类的性别和年龄差异。
我们比较特征标准化与典型的零平均值和单位差异SVM(适应于训练折叠),以及样本L2正常化(不需要训练).
报告结果时,要么是用整个面部,要么用视线区域作为投入。
`视力 ' 栏指单独分类的左眼和右眼,而`视力L+R ' 在SVM分类前均指双眼描述符。

Rows gain refer to the accuracy increase when initialising the CNN in the same domain vs a different domain.

Rows gain refer to the accuracy increase when initialising the CNN in the same domain vs a different domain.

blocks.en:
The results show a clear dependency between the pre-training domain and the input region.
Networks pre-trained for face recognition perform better with full-face images, whereas ocular-recognition pre-training performs better with ocular images.
This is particularly pronounced for ocular data, especially in age estimation (Table 4 ).
For example, with MB2/R50 and L2-normalised features, ocular pre-training improves exact and 1-off ocular age accuracy by 18-22%.
In ocular gender estimation (Table 3 ), improvements of 10-15% are also observed with MB2/R50 and same-domain pre-training.
blocks.zh:
结果显示,培训前领域与投入区之间明显依赖。
预先接受面部识别培训的网络用全面图像表现得更好,而视力识别前培训用视力图像表现得更好。
这一点在视力数据方面尤为突出,特别是在年龄估计方面(表4)。
例如,具有MB2/R50和L2常态化特征的远视前训练提高了精确度和1-off远视年龄精确度18-2%.
在观察性别估计(表3)中,MB2/R50和同域前培训也提高了10-15%。

blocks.en:
Combining both eyes also consistently improves performance for both gender and age. Regarding feature scaling, L2 normalisation generally outperforms standardisation and requires no additional training.
This is consistent with the representation employed by modern recognition networks, in which feature embeddings are L2-normalised, and discrimination is based primarily on angular relationships, such as cosine similarity [ Wang et al., 2018 ] .
It can also be observed that the performance gap between face and ocular L+R is small:
84.8% vs 82.9% for gender, 57.6% vs 56.6% for exact age, and 93.7% vs 92.0% for 1-off age, respectively.
These results suggest that the ocular region retains much of the demographic information available in the full face, provided that pre-training matches the input region and both eyes are combined.
blocks.zh:
将双眼结合起来,也不断提高性别和年龄的表现。 关于特征缩放,L2正常化一般优于标准化,不需要额外培训。
这与现代识别网络使用的代表方式一致,其中特征嵌入是L2常态化的,歧视主要基于角关系,如余弦相似性[Wang等人,2018].
也可以观察到面部和视光L+R之间的性能差距很小:
性别为84.8%对82.9%,具体年龄为57.6%对56.6%,1岁以上年龄为93.7%对92.0%。
这些结果表明,视线区域保留了大部分现有的人口信息,前提是培训前与输入区域匹配,双眼结合。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Effect of λ ord \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}} on age estimation accuracy, averaged over the five test folds. λ ord = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}=0 corresponds to standard cross-entropy without the ordinal term.
blocks.zh: 图3: ord\lambda\ mathrm{ord}对年龄估计准确性的影响,平均为5个测试折叠. & ## ord = 0\lambda ## mathrm #ord #####0 对应标准横切,没有正切词.

blocks.en: 4.2 Fine-tuning for soft-biometrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 软生物计量的微调

blocks.en:
We compare two strategies (Tables 5 , 6 ): ’Frozen’, where only the last classification layer is trained, and ’Unfrozen’, allowing end-to-end fine-tuning. The first is conceptually similar to the SVM experiments but with a neural network classifier.
Unlike the SVM experiments, ’Ocular L+R’ averages the softmax scores of both eyes rather than their descriptors.
To assess the benefit of identity pre-training, we also evaluate direct ImageNet initialisation and training from scratch in the ’Unfrozen’ setting.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了两种策略(表5、表6): " 冻结 " ,只有最后一个分类层经过训练; " 解冻 " ,允许端到端微调。 第一个在概念上与SVM实验相似,但有一个神经网络分类器.
与SVM实验不同, 'Oclar L+R'平均双眼的软最大分数而不是其描述符.
为了评估身份前培训的好处,我们还从头到尾评估 " 解冻 " 背景下的直接图像网络启动和培训。

blocks.en:
Matching the pre-training and input domains is important, particularly with frozen features, yielding gains of up to 18.3%, 20.8%, and 23.1% for gender, exact age, and 1-off age, respectively.
These gains decrease to approximately 3-9% with end-to-end fine-tuning, indicating reduced domain dependence if the network is allowed to adapt its representations.
Nevertheless, the best accuracies are obtained with end-to-end training and matched pre-training domains.
In all unfrozen configurations, ImageNet initialisation outperforms scratch, while matched identity pre-training further improves accuracy over ImageNet, in some cases by 10-20%, especially in age estimation.
Since the identity networks themselves start from ImageNet, this highlights the benefit of the additional face/ocular identity pre-training stage.
Combining both eyes consistently improves ocular performance as well, narrowing the gap with the full face, especially for age: 57.7% vs 56.8% exact and 91.9% vs 94.0% 1-off accuracy (ocular L+R vs face).
For gender, the gap is larger (82.8% vs 88.1%).
blocks.zh:
将培训前和投入领域相匹配很重要,尤其是与冷冻特征相匹配,在性别、确切年龄和1岁以上年龄方面分别提高18.3%、20.8%和23.1%。
这些增益随着端到端的微调降低到约3-9%,表明如果允许网络调整其表示,域依赖性就会降低.
尽管如此,通过端到端培训以及匹配的预培训领域,还是取得了最好的成绩。
在所有解冻配置中,ImageNet初始化的完成率都超过了抓痕,而匹配的身份前训练则进一步提高了ImageNet的精度,在某些情况下还提高了10-20%,特别是在年龄估计方面.
由于身份网络本身是从ImageNet开始的,这凸显了额外面部/视觉身份培训前阶段的好处。
双眼结合也不断提高视力,缩小了与全面(尤其是年龄)的差距:57.7%对56.8%准确,91.9%对94.0%准确(视力L+R对面).
性别差距较大(82.8%对88.1%)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ordinal loss for multi-class classification
blocks.zh: 4.3 多类分类的正常损失

blocks.en:
The standard cross-entropy loss ℒ C ​ E = − log ⁡ p y \mathcal{L}_{CE}=-\log p_{y} ignores the ordering of age groups.
Previous t-SNE visualisations suggested a tendency for nearby age groups to occupy neighbouring regions in the learned feature space [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] , further motivating the exploitation of their ordinal structure.
We thus introduce an ordinal penalty that increases with the distance from the true age group y y ( y = 1 , … , 8 y=1,\ldots,8 ):
blocks.zh:
LC E = – log p y\ mathcal{L}_{CE}=-\log p_{y}的标准跨性损失忽略了各年龄段的顺序.
以往的t-SNE可视化表明,附近年龄组往往会占据所学地物空间中的邻近地区[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年],从而进一步激发了对其正体结构的利用。
因此,我们引入了法定惩罚,随着与真年龄组y(y=1,.,8y=1,ldots,8)的距离而增加:

blocks.en: ℒ = ℒ C ​ E + λ ord ​ ∑ j = 1 K p j ​ ( j − y K − 1 ) 2 \mathcal{L}=\mathcal{L}_{CE}+\lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}\sum_{j=1}^{K}p_{j}\left(\frac{j-y}{K-1}\right)^{2} (1)
blocks.zh: L = L C E + + + + r j = 1 K p j (j - y K - 1) 2\ mathcal{ L}=\ mathcal{ L}_{CE}+\lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}\sum_{j=1}^{K}p_{j}\左 (\frac{j-y}{K-1}\右)^{2} (1)

blocks.en:
Here, p j p_{j} is the predicted probability for age group j j , and K = 8 K=8 is the number of age groups. The squared distance penalises larger age-group errors, with maximum cost normalised to one.
The penalty operates on age-group indices rather than chronological age differences, since the groups have unequal age ranges.
Figure 3 analyses the effect of λ ord \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}} . Increasing λ ord \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}} generally improves 1-off test accuracy across networks and input regions, with less consistent effects on exact accuracy.
This is expected, as the ordinal penalty prioritises reducing large age-group errors over exact classification.
Performance saturates around λ ord = 20 \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}}=20 , which we select as a compromise between exact and 1-off metrics.
Table 7 compares these results with the best SVM and conventional end-to-end configurations of the previous two subsections.
With the selected λ ord \lambda_{\mathrm{ord}} , the ordinal loss yields higher 1-off age accuracy than conventional end-to-end training in all evaluated configurations, reaching 95.2% for face and 93.1% for ocular L+R, while exact accuracy improves in most configurations.
blocks.zh:
这里,p j p_{j}是预测的年龄组 j 的概率,而K = 8 K = 8 是年龄组的数量. 平方距离对较大的年龄群体错误进行惩罚,最高费用是正常的。
惩罚是根据年龄组指数而不是按年龄划分的,因为这些年龄组的年龄范围不平等。
图3 分析 QQ ORD\lambda\ mathrm{ord}的影响。 增加 \\ lambda\ mathrm{ ord} 总体上提高了网络和输入区域的1- 关闭测试精度, 对准确精度的影响不太一致。
由于法定惩罚优先减少大宗年龄组错误,而不是精确的分类,预计会如此。
性能饱和度在 = 20\lambda\ mathrm\ ord\ 20左右,我们选择它作为精确度和1度值的折中值。
表7将这些结果与前两个小节的最佳SVM和常规端对端配置进行比较.
随着所选的\ rd\ lambda\ mathrm{ ord} , 在所有评价的配置中, 平均损失的1-off年龄准确度高于常规的端对端训练, 面值为95.2%, 视星等为93.1%, 而大多数配置的准确度都有所提高 。

Bold values indicate the highest accuracy achieved by our proposed methods for each network and task, while grey-shaded cells indicate the best accuracy reported in previous work. Ordinal loss results use λ \lambda =20. Comparisons are indicative because experimental protocols, age classes or number of images per fold may differ.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison with previous works
blocks.zh: 4.4 与以往工程的比较

blocks.en:
Table 7 also compares our results with previous work using the Adience database.
However, differences in image subsets, evaluation protocols, age-group definitions, and external training data prevent strict comparisons.
Thus, the results provide a contextual comparison rather than a strict ranking.
blocks.zh:
表7还利用Adience数据库将我们的成果与以前的工作进行比较。
然而,在图像子集,评价协议,年龄组定义,以及外部培训数据上的差异阻碍了严格的比较.
因此,结果提供了背景比较,而不是严格的排名。

blocks.en:
Most of the literature using Adience employs full-face images.
For gender estimation, our best face accuracy is 88.1% with R50 and end-to-end training,
improving the original 77.8% baseline [ Eidinger et al., 2014 ] and our previous results on the same image subset but with a different training regime [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] .
MB2 follows closely with 87.5%, and the shallower SQ still achieves a competitive 85%.
Values above 90% have also been reported, although several of these works employ different experimental settings or additional architectural components.
For example, [ Fang et al., 2019 ] combines global and local information and their interaction through dedicated layers, using an 80/20 train-test partition instead of the predefined Adience folds.
The work [ Khan et al., 2020 ] uses probabilistic maps to classify image pixels into seven categories (hair, eyebrows, eyes, etc.), then extracts and concatenates CNN features from each category map, and performs 10-fold cross-validation.
In [ Benkaddour, 2021 ] , images from the same subjects appear in both training and test sets, potentially leading to optimistic accuracy estimates,
while [ Ghrban and Abbadi, 2023 ] evaluates a wavelet-scattering-based pipeline on a reduced subset of 8,888 Adience images.
MiVOLO [ Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023 ] uses Adience as a test set after training a transformer-based architecture of 27.4M parameters on 500,000 proprietary images from the external Lagenda database.
In [ Singh and Singh, 2024 ] , they combine a pre-trained ViT-B/32 transformer with additional BiLSTM-based sequencer blocks. This is a substantially larger architecture, since a standard ViT-B/32 alone contains ≃ \simeq 88M parameters, more than three times the count of a ResNet50.
Finally, [ Waris et al., 2024 ] combines learned CNN descriptors with a soft-voting ensemble of multiple machine-learning classifiers.
blocks.zh:
大部分使用Adience的文献都采用了全面图像.
就性别估计而言,我们最好的面部精度是88.1%,有R50和端对端训练,
改进原先77.8%的基线[Eidinger等人,2014年],以及我们以前在同一图像子集上的结果,但采用不同的培训制度[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]。
MB2紧跟87.5%,较浅的SQ仍然实现了85%的竞争.
还报告了超过90%的数值,尽管其中一些工程采用了不同的实验环境或额外的建筑构件。
例如,[Fang等人,2019]通过专用层将全球信息和本地信息及其相互作用结合起来,使用80/20列车测试分区,而不是预先定义的Adience折叠.
该作品[Khan et al., 2020]使用概率图将图像像素分类为七个类别(头发,眉毛,眼睛等),然后从每个类别图中提取和整理CNN特征,并进行10倍的交叉验证.
在[Benkaddour, 2021]中,来自相同科目的图像同时出现在培训和测试集中,有可能导致乐观的准确性估计,
而[Ghrban and Abbadi, 2023]则在减少的子集8,888 Adience图像上评价一个波纹-散射的管道.
MiVOLO [Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023]在外部Lagenda数据库的50万个专有图像上培训了基于变压器的27.4M参数的架构后,将Adience作为测试集.
在[Singh and Singh, 2024]中,它们结合了预先训练的VIT-B/32变压器和额外的基于BiLSTM的测序器块. 这是一个大得多的架构,因为仅一个标准的Vit-B/32就包含\\\simeq 88M参数,超过ResNet50的3倍.
最后,[Waris et al., 2024]结合了有学问的CNN描述符和由多个机器学习分类器组成的柔和投票组合.

blocks.en:
For face-based age, our best exact and 1-off accuracies are 57.6% (R50 with SVM) and 95.2% (R50 with ordinal loss), respectively. MB2 falls just behind, and the shallower SQ remains competitive.
The highest reported exact accuracies include [ Benkaddour, 2021 ] (91.75%),
with subject overlap between training and test sets, and [ Singh and Singh, 2024 ] (84.91%), with the very large ViT-B/32 + BiLSTM model.
In addition, the work [ Benkaddour, 2021 ] employs 6 age groups instead of the original 8, merging 0-2 with 4-6 and 8-13 with 15-20.
The mentioned method of [ Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023 ] , trained on 500,000 proprietary images, reports 68.69% exact face age accuracy.
Other methods surpassing our approach include [ Gyawali et al., 2020 ] (70.96%), which uses an 80/20 train-test split for each age class rather than the predefined five-fold Adience protocol,
and [ Zhang et al., 2020 ] (67.83%), which combines a residual network with an attention-LSTM architecture, and importantly, age-specific pre-training on the large IMDB-WIKI-101 database.
In 1-off face age accuracy, our approach is only surpassed by [ Zhang et al., 2020 ] among the compared works.
blocks.zh:
就面部年龄而言,我们最好的精确度和1-1的速率分别为57.6%(R50与SVM)和95.2%(R50与正常损失)。 MB2刚刚落后,较浅的SQ仍然具有竞争力.
报告的最高精确速率包括[本卡杜尔,2021](91.75%),
和[Singh and Singh, 2024](84.91%), 和非常大的VIT-B/32 + BiLSTM模型。
此外,该作品[Benkaddour,2021]雇用了6个年龄组,而不是原来的8个年龄组,将0-2与4-6合并,8-13与15-20合并.
上面提到的[Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023]方法, 训练了50万张专有图像,
其他超越我们方法的方法包括[Gyawali等人,2020年](70.96%),它使用每个年龄等级的80/20次列车分试,而不是预先确定的五倍Adience协议,
和 [张等人,2020年] (67.83%),将残余网络与关注-LSTM架构相结合,更重要的是,大型IMDB-WIKI-101数据库上的针对年龄的预训.
在1-off的面年龄精确度中,我们的方法仅被比较作品中的[张等人,2020年]超越.

blocks.en:
Previous work using only the ocular region of Adience is considerably more limited.
For gender estimation, we achieve 81.3% on individual eyes, and 82.9% when combining both eyes.
This improves our previous results on the same subset [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] by more than 4%. Our ocular gender results also approach those of [ Bhattacharyya et al., 2019 ] (84.06%, single eye) and [ Ghrban and Abbadi, 2023 ] (83.34%, both eyes), although these works use different image subsets and experimental protocols.
The largest improvement is in ocular age estimation, where, to the best of our knowledge,
our best observed accuracies are the highest reported on Adience
56.2/59.0% exact and 91.9/93.1% 1-off (single eye/both eyes).
Compared with [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] on the same subset, exact accuracy improves by over 10% and 1-off accuracy by 7-9%, also surpassing earlier results of [ Rattani et al., 2017 ] .
blocks.zh:
以前只使用Adience地区的工作较为有限。
就性别估计而言,我们在个人眼上达到81.3%,在结合双眼时达到82.9%。
这使我们以前在同一子集[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]上的结果提高了4%以上。 我们的视差性别结果也接近[Bhattacharyya等人,2019年](84.06%,单眼)和[Ghrban和Abbadi,2023年](83.34%,双眼),尽管这些作品使用不同的图像子集和实验协议.
最大的改进是视年龄估计, 根据我们所知,
我们观测到的最高强度是关于Adience的报告最高
56.2/59.0%准确,91.9/93.1%1-off(单眼/双眼).
与同一子集的[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]相比,精确的准确度提高了10%以上,1-off的准确度提高了7-9%,也超过了早先的[Rattani等人,2017年]的结果.

blocks.en: 5 CONCLUSIONS
blocks.zh: 五、结 论

blocks.en:
We investigated the transfer of identity-recognition representations to face and ocular gender and age estimation.
Three architectures (SqueezeNet, MobileNetv2, and ResNet50) were evaluated as fixed feature extractors with SVM classification and through task-specific end-to-end adaptation.
Experiments on 11,299 Adience smartphone images showed
the importance of matching the pre-training domain to the target image region.
Face-recognition pre-training performs better for full-face inputs, whereas ocular-recognition pre-training provides larger gains for ocular images.
End-to-end fine-tuning mitigates domain mismatch, but matched identity pre-training still performs best, outperforming direct ImageNet initialisation and training from scratch.
Since both identity-pretrained variants originate from ImageNet, our results demonstrate the benefit of additional identity training for transferring representations to soft-biometric prediction.
We also introduce an ordinal loss for age estimation penalising age-group errors according to their distance from the true class.
The proposed ordinal loss yields higher observed 1-off accuracy across architectures and regions, with smaller and less uniform gains in exact accuracy, consistent with its objective of discouraging predictions far from the correct age group.
blocks.zh:
我们调查了身份识别表述向面貌和视线性别和年龄估计的转移。
三种架构(SqueezeNet,MobileNetv2,和ResNet50)被评价为具有SVM分类的固定特性提取器,并通过特定任务端到端的改造.
11,299次实验 显示的辅助智能手机图像
将培训前域与目标图像区域匹配的重要性。
面部识别前培训对全面输入效果较好,而视力识别前培训则为视力图像带来更大的收益。
端到端的微调可以缓解域位不匹配,但匹配的身份预训仍然表现最好,表现优于直接的ImageNet初始化和从零开始的培训.
由于两个身份预先训练的变体都来自ImageNet,我们的结果表明,为将表达法转移到软生物计量预测法而增加身份培训的好处。
我们还引入了按年龄估计的正常损失,根据年龄群体与真正阶级的距离来惩罚他们。
拟议的平面损失使各建筑和各区域观察到的1落精度更高,准确准确度的提高较小,不太统一,这符合其阻止远离正确年龄组的预测的目标。

blocks.en:
Several additional observations emerge from our experiments.
For SVM classification, sample-wise L2 normalisation consistently outperforms feature-wise standardisation typically employed with SVMs, while combining both eyes improves both gender and age estimation.
Our strongest results are obtained with ResNet50 in most settings, but the smaller
MobileNetv2 and SqueezeNet remain competitive.
This suggests that useful soft-biometric representations do not necessarily require large architectures.
We also observed that the ocular region retains much of the demographic information available in the full face, particularly when
pre-training and target domains match.
For gender, our best accuracies are 88.1% (face) and 82.9% (ocular, both eyes combined), whereas the difference is smaller for age.
With the ordinal loss, ocular (both eyes) achieves 59.0/93.1% (exact/1-off age accuracy), compared with 56.6/95.2% for the full face.
For ocular age, this improves previous results on the same Adience subset [ Alonso-Fernandez et al., 2021 ] by more than 10% in exact accuracy and by 7-9% in 1-off accuracy.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验还发现了一些其他的观测结果。
就SVM分类而言,抽样的L2正常化一贯优于通常与SVMs一起使用的特征标准化,同时将双眼结合起来,既能改善性别和年龄估计。
我们最强的结果是在大多数情况下通过ResNet50获得,但越小
MobileNetv2和挤压 网络仍然具有竞争力。
这表明有用的软生物计量表示不一定需要大型架构.
我们还注意到,眼球区保留了大部分现有人口信息,特别是当人们看到这些人口信息时。
预训和目标域匹配。
就性别而言,我们的最佳敏锐度是88.1%(面)和82.9%(视力,双眼结合),而年龄差别较小。
眼部(双眼)的视差为59.0/93.1%(准确的1/off年龄精确度),而全面的视差为56.6/95.2%。
对于眼球年龄来说,这使以前在同一Adience子集[Alonso-Fernandez等人,2021年]上的结果准确性提高了10%以上,1-off精度提高了7-9%.

blocks.en:
Despite these gains, some previous face-based approaches report considerably higher accuracy, although often under different experimental settings, architectures, or training regimes.
This leaves substantial room for improvement with the ocular modality, particularly for exact age classification.
We will thus investigate the adaptation of more advanced face-based methods to ocular estimation, such as
explicitly modelling local and global information via dedicated layers [ Fang et al., 2019 ] , transformer and attention mechanisms [ Zhang et al., 2020 , Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023 , Singh and Singh, 2024 ] ,
or using substantially larger training sets with soft-biometrics labels [ Zhang et al., 2020 , Kuprashevich and Tolstykh, 2023 ] .
Finally, more sophisticated ordinal-learning formulations will be investigated to improve exact classification without sacrificing 1-off performance.
Evaluation on additional datasets and cross-database settings will also help assess generalisation.
blocks.zh:
尽管取得了这些进展,但以往的一些面对面做法的准确性要高得多,尽管在不同的试验环境、结构或培训制度下往往如此。
这给视线模式,特别是精确的年龄分类,留下了很大的改进余地。
因此,我们将调查更先进的面基方法是否适用于视光估计,例如:
[Fang等人,2019年],变压器和注意机制[ 张等,2020年 库普拉谢维奇和托尔斯泰赫,2023年 辛格和辛格,2024年],
[ 张等, 2020年 库普拉谢维奇与托尔斯泰赫, 2023].
最后,将调查更精密的普通学习配方,以改进准确的分类,同时不牺牲1-1的性能。
对更多数据集和跨数据库设置的评价也有助于评估通用性。

blocks.en: ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS
